Bendos Action Figure Lot - 8 Pieces
Kid Galaxy, Mixed Series
1999-2001, Factory Sealed / New In Packaging
This collection features eight vintage Bendos posable action figures by Kid Galaxy, dating from the late 1990s and early 2000s. Known for their "bend 'em, pose 'em" flexibility and imaginative character designs, Bendos became a beloved collector's line for their unique aesthetic and tactile play value. This lot includes a diverse range of characters from multiple series, all remaining in their original retail packaging.
Figures Included:
Chops Martial Artist (#1606) - Series 3, Original Boxed Packaging
Mistletoe Elf (#245) - Series 3, Original Tube Packaging
Swat Alien (#064) - Series 2, Original Tube Packaging
Bogey Golfer (#265) - Series 3, Original Tube Packaging
Winnie Horse Rider (#084) - Original Tube Packaging
Ben Dough Chef (#235) - Series 3, Original Tube Packaging
Allie Best Friend (#225) - Series 3, Original Tube Packaging
Linkbug Snowboarder (#020) - Original Tube Packaging
Condition:
All eight figures are factory sealed in their original packaging. The clear plastic tubes exhibit typical shelf wear including light surface scratches and minor yellowing consistent with age. The cardboard box for "Chops" shows minor edge wear and light creasing at the top flap. Original retail price stickers are present on several packages. Figures appear in mint condition through the clear windows.
